test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements related to the river Godavari is INCORRECT?

options.text: The Ghatprabha is one of its many tributaries.
It drains into the Bay of Bengal.
It rises from the slopes of the Western Ghats.
Its drainage basin covers Andhra Pradesh and some other states.

solution:
The correct answer is__** The Ghatprabha is one of its many tributaries.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Godavari river is the second-longest river in India, after the river Ganges.**
 
• **It originates from the Trimbakeshwar plateau in Maharashtra and flows for a distance of 1,465 km before draining into the Bay of Bengal.**
 
• The river has many tributaries, including the **Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, Manjira, and Wainganga rivers.**
 
• The Godavari river basin covers an area of 312,812 km, spread over several states, including Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Ghatprabha river is a tributary of the river Krishna, which originates in the Western Ghats and flows through the states of Karnataka and Maharashtra before joining the Krishna river.**
 
• The European White Stork, Demoiselle Crane, and other migratory bird species are among the many that make Ghataprabha notable.
 
• **The Ghataprabha river has the Markandeya and Hiranyakeshi rivers as tributaries.**
